description: Prompt for repairing a blocked ticket's image on the Mac (the grouped engines' Blocked, ASS-392): the project's golden image, the ticket's VM cloned from it, or the project's local registry — re-checking first whether the problem is still there (a build may have finished while it waited), one golden rebuild at a time (a build running: golden-building, the harness waits), and only within its limits: registry:up, the image definition in the project's golden-image folder through vm:golden-write, vm:build-golden-start, vm:recreate — nothing else on the Mac, never a credential; fixed only when the failing check passes on a VM from the repaired image; logs what it found and changed, cites only what it read

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the block: summary, root cause, evidence, its classification
input-arguments.example: golden image pulls an amd64-only image on an arm64 Mac

golden-building.description: true when a build of the project's golden image runs now — found running, or started by this run — so the harness waits for it, no failure counted, then runs the repair again to re-check

fixed.description: true when the failing check passes on a VM from the repaired image

problem-gone.description: true when the re-check found the original problem already gone (a build since the block fixed it)

evidence.description: The commands run and what each showed

ai-feedback-short.description: Fixed: what was done; building: the build waited for; else what the operator must do — one line, shown on the dashboard

ai-feedback-long.description: What was found, what was tried or done, and what must be done
